sites.downstream: result.object (genre label) logged to stdout; result.usage and result.finishReason also logged
sites.reason: Closed-set enum selection over 5 fixed genre labels from a hardcoded trusted prompt. No math, date logic, multi-hop reasoning, generation, or adversarial input. Small focused context well within Jev limits.

options.benefit: Jev Choice is purpose-built for closed-set label selection. Expected lower per-request cost than gpt-4o-mini for accepted decisions. Cascade cost = Jev cost + (fallback fraction × original cost). Latency: Jev p50 likely faster than gpt-4o-mini for single-label classification; serial miss adds Jev latency before original.
options.risk: Conservative fallback retained; worst case is added Jev latency on low-confidence inputs before original path runs. No behavior change on fallback.
